newsitem.title: FRANCE: HORSE RACING-PEINTRE CELEBRE OUT OF BIG ASCOT RACE.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-PEINTRE CELEBRE OUT OF BIG ASCOT RACE.

text.p: Crack French colt Peintre Celebre will miss the King George VI and Queen Elizabeth Diamond Stakes at Ascot on July 26, owner Daniel Wilddenstein said on Tuesday.
Connections have had a change of plan even though the Peintre Celebre team were all set to compete after the horse followed up his French Derby win in the Grand Prix de Paris at Longchamp on Sunday.
The Andre Fabre charge will now have his campaign geared towards winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe on October 5.
Defending Arc champion Helissio is scheduled to have his King George VI warm-up race in Paris on Sunday.
Helissio is expected to defend his crown in the group one Grand Prix de Saint-Cloud after working well on Monday.
